## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing, `go vet ./...` and `go test -race ./...` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has a test
- [ ] README (EN, RU, UZ) and `docs/manual-testing.md` updated if user-visible behaviour changed
- [ ] No new `bd` writes, or they are confirmed by the user and listed in the README
- [ ] Commit messages use `feat:` / `fix:` / `docs:` / `chore:` prefixes
